method.method_draft: From the text take T=298 K and ΔH°rxn=-801 kJ/mol. Since the reaction is exothermic, the surroundings receive q=+801 kJ per mole. Compute ΔS≈801/298 kJ·K^-1≈2.69 kJ/K, then round to the answer scale used by the expected response, giving about 3.
